faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What people usually ask about banks, cash, receipts and plans.
faq.writeUs: Write to us and we'll reply by email.

safe.q: Is it safe to connect my bank?
safe.a: The connection uses PSD2 with read-only access: mypocket can see your balances and transactions, but never move your money.

several.q: Can I connect several banks at once?
several.a: Yes. The combined balance adds up all your accounts and each keeps its own balance. The Free plan includes 1 bank; Pro, unlimited.

disconnect.q: How do I disconnect a bank?

track.q: How do I track my cash?
track.a: With a cash balance where you log manual income and expenses. It's added to your total balance like any other account.

noBank.q: Can I use mypocket without connecting a bank?
noBank.a: Yes. You can keep your cash balance, log manual income and expenses, and connect a bank whenever you want.

how.q: How does the receipt scanner work?
how.a: You take a photo of the receipt, OCR reads the store, date and amount, and finds the matching transaction in your banks to link it.

cash.a: If no bank transaction matches, you can create a cash expense from the receipt.

free.q: What does the Free plan include?
free.a: 1 connected bank, a cash balance with manual transactions and a monthly summary.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
